kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the definitions, the four reading rules, and the table only; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-dials reading protocol (Km = the affinity dial at [S] = 1/2 Vmax; Vmax = the capacity dial set by enzyme head-count; exactly ONE dial moves per inhibitor class) and the geometry decode of the Lineweaver-Burk intercepts (Y-intercept = 1/Vmax, X-intercept = −1/Km, slope = Km/Vmax) — KYP's synthesis of the page's definitions, rules, and table into one protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the definitions, the rules, and the table as separate blocks and never states the one-dial-per-inhibitor invariant; the two-dials framing and the dial-routing pivot are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanism km-affinity-map + the registry visual's panels + pivots

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (HALF-SPEED SUBSTRATE, HEAD-COUNT CEILING / HUG THE ZERO — Y-HUG LIFTS VMAX, X-HUG LIFTS KM / CROSSERS SHARE THE Y-AXIS; NONCROSSERS SHARE THE X-AXIS / COMPETITION BENDS POTENCY; EVICTION BREAKS EFFICACY) — no mnemonic prints on the page (VLM confirmed).
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 228 (VLM census confirmed; the only margin glyph is a small key icon beside two panels); the four codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics + rapidReview.m3 + the visual's rule cards

kypExtensions.summary: The allosteric-inhibitor miniCase (binding site distinct from the active site, no substrate homology, Vmax ↓ with Km unchanged, shared X-intercept, no crossing, doubling [S] restores nothing) with the irreversible-competitive near-miss distractor — the two table columns that are numerically identical separated only by Bind site and Resemble substrate.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the table columns side by side and never asks the learner to separate the identically-numbered Vmax-movers from binding data; the vignette and the four distractors are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM, ph1-vlm-census.ts): ZERO raster images on pdf 250 / book 228 — FOUR VECTOR curve panels (VLM: the single Michaelis-Menten hyperbola with dashed 1/2 Vmax meeting the curve at Km, the 'Km = [S] at 1/2 Vmax' annotation and the Saturation arrow; the effects-of-inhibition Michaelis-Menten overlay with Uninhibited / Competitive inhibitor (reversible) / Noncompetitive inhibitor; the single Lineweaver-Burk line with Y-intercept 1/Vmax, X-intercept −1/Km and slope = Km/Vmax; the effects-of-inhibition Lineweaver-Burk overlay with the same three lines) plus the pure-text inhibition table; no margin mnemonics print (VLM: only a small key-icon glyph beside two panels). THE INTERLEAVE (documented, at the batch's densest): the text layer fuses labels across panels — 'VmaxVmax', 'CompetitiveK inhibitor' fused with '= [S] at 1/2(reversible)' (the Competitive inhibitor (reversible) curve label fused with the Km = [S] at 1/2 Vmax annotation), '− Km 1⁄2 V1/2 Vmax', 'Km Km Substrate [S]', and the table's header/first rows physically interleave with the figure clusters (raw 89-101, 155-188) while the lower four rows stream clean (raw 190-220). QUIRKS, documented: (1) the source's own printed typo — 'Kompetitive inhibitors increase K m.' — prints in red in the left column directly beneath the crossing rule ('Reversible competitive inhibitors cross each other, whereas noncompetitive inhibitors do not.') and above the Lineweaver-Burk inhibition panel and the table (VLM confirmed the capital K as printed); KYP carries it verbatim in the note's callout block and visual Panel 3. (2) TABLE ROW ORDER: the production spec assumed Bind site first, but both the VLM reading and a layout-preserved pdftotext pass confirm the printed order is Resemble substrate → Overcome by ↑ [S] → Bind site → Effect on Vmax → Effect on Km → Pharmacodynamics; the verbatim table block and the visual's Panel 4 carry the PRINTED order. (3) The indd footer slug (FAS1_2026_05-Pharmacology.indd 228) prints mid-stream (raw 103), not adjacent to the timestamp (raw 222), so the two print-line components are quoted as two contiguous-range entries. (4) Outputs are STAGED under .usmle-pipeline-cache/staging-ph1/ — nothing is written into content/ (chapters/pharmacology.json, content manifests, visual-inventory, and the visual registry are owned by the promotion step; the note's visualId 'enzyme-kinetics-map' is therefore not yet in visuals/registry.tsx by design).
